Why fly into Bratislava? It is the cheapest outbound that leaves after 12:00. A direct bus takes about 1h20 to Vienna (about 30 departures a day, from €4.98 each on FlixBus). Only small free bags are included in these prices. A checked bag costs extra.

Day by day

Sat 7
Drive to Thessaloniki and check in (B2). Waterfront, White Tower, dinner.
Sun 8
Our day in Thessaloniki: Aristotelous Square, the Modiano market, dinner in Ladadika, the Upper Town for the view.
Mon 9
Leave about 12:00, park at P3, fly 15:50 → 16:40 to Bratislava. Bus to Vienna (1h20), arriving about 19:00. Check in, easy dinner nearby.
Tue 10
Old town: Stephansdom and Graben. Naschmarkt for lunch. Schönbrunn Christmas market in the evening.
Wed 11
Belvedere in the morning. Hotpot in the evening at Chili & Pepper Hotpot, then a stout at 1516 Brewing Co.
Thu 12
Prater and the Riesenrad. Colombian dinner at Casa Mora, then craft beer at Mel's Craft Beers & Diner.
Fri 13
The big Rathausplatz and Spittelberg markets open. Go in the afternoon and stay into the evening.
Sat 14
A Heuriger (wine tavern) for very dry Grüner Veltliner or Gemischter Satz. More markets and a last dinner.
Sun 15
Slow morning. Leave the apartment about 15:00, S7 to the airport, fly 18:35 → 21:25. Then drive home (A1) or sleep in Thessaloniki (A2).

Eat and drink

Hotpot

Chili & Pepper Hotpot, Burggasse 123, listed Mon–Fri 12–15 and 17:30–22:30. Backup: HEY! HOTPOT, Strozzigasse 36.

Colombian

Casa Mora. Arepas, empanadas, patacones. A reviewer called it the closest to Colombian food in Vienna.

Stouts and craft beer

1516 Brewing Co. (a stout among its staples), The Highlander, Mel's Craft Beers & Diner (400+ beers). See the craft beer guide.

BBQ

I could not find a real American smokehouse in Vienna. Only Hard Rock Cafe came up, so this is not a confirmed pick.

Restaurant tips come from guides of mixed age. Check hours before you go.

Weather and what to wear

ViennaThessaloniki
Daytime highabout 5–9°Cabout 15–18°C
Night lowabout 0–2°Cabout 7–10°C
Rainabout 12 rainy days in the monthabout 4–13 rainy days

These are November averages, not a forecast. Vienna is cold, damp and grey in November.

  • Shoes: waterproof hiking boots are a good fit. They give grip on wet cobbles and keep feet dry at the markets. Wear them on the plane and break them in first.
  • Warm coat, hat and gloves for Vienna, plus a spare pair of dry socks in the day bag.
